name: Al Kharid
blurb: Al Kharid is a large city in the north of the Kharidian Desert, and the only desert city open to non-members.

name: Aldarin
blurb: Aldarin is a large island off the south-west coast of Varlamore.

name: Ape Atoll
blurb: Ape Atoll is an island in the Ardent Ocean of Gielinor, home to a vibrant population of monkeys.

name: Arceuus
blurb: Arceuus is one of the five cities in the Kingdom of Great Kourend.

name: Ardougne Zoo
blurb: The Ardougne Zoo, located in the southern part of East Ardougne, holds a variety of creatures gathered from across Gielinor.

name: Barbarian Village
blurb: Barbarian Village is a small village south of Edgeville and west of Varrock.

name: Barrows
blurb: The Barrows is a series of six burial mounds east of Mort'ton in which the Barrows brothers were entombed after their deaths during the Third Age.

name: Baxtorian Falls
blurb: The Baxtorian Falls is a small series of water rapids flowing southwards from the Lunar Sea to the River Dougne, featured in the Waterfall Quest.

name: Brimhaven
blurb: Brimhaven is a members-only pirate town located on north-western Karamja, led by the wealthy Scarface Pete.

name: Burgh de Rott
blurb: Burgh de Rott is a desolate town located in the south-western coast of Morytania, known for housing the human resistance to the oppressive vampyres.

name: Burthorpe
blurb: The Principality of Burthorpe, referred to colloquially as Burthorpe, is a military principality north-west of Falador and north of Taverley.

name: Camelot
blurb: The castle of Camelot is located in Kandarin, to the east of Seers' Village.

name: Canifis
blurb: Canifis, formerly known as Kharyrll, is a small town in Morytania inhabited by werewolves in human form.

name: Castle Drakan
blurb: Castle Drakan is the seat of power of Morytania and the stronghold from which Lowerniel Drakan rules the region.

name: Castle Wars
blurb: Castle Wars is a free-to-play combat minigame similar to Capture the Flag, but with a Old School RuneScape twist.

name: Catherby
blurb: Catherby is a small, members-only fishing town located immediately west White Wolf Mountain.

name: Champions' Guild
blurb: The Champions' Guild is located south of Varrock and is accessible to players with at least 32 quest points.

name: Corsair Cove
blurb: Corsair Cove is a small port town located on the southern shore of Feldip Hills.

name: Crafting Guild
blurb: The Crafting Guild is located south-west of Falador and north of Rimmington.

name: Crandor
blurb: Crandor is a small volcanic island north of Karamja.

name: Darkmeyer
blurb: Darkmeyer is the capital city of Morytania located in the Sanguinesti region, north of Meiyerditch.

name: Digsite
blurb: The Digsite is an archaeological excavation area just east of Varrock.

name: Draynor Manor
blurb: Draynor Manor is a large, haunted, mansion located north of Draynor Village owned by Count Draynor Drakan.

name: Draynor Village
blurb: Draynor Village, often shortened to Draynor, is a small village located between Falador and Lumbridge.

name: Duel Arena
blurb: The Al Kharid Duel Arena was a place where players could go to engage in one-on-one Combat.

name: East Ardougne
blurb: East Ardougne is the eastern of the two districts that form Ardougne, the capital of Kandarin.

name: Ectofuntus
blurb: The Ectofuntus is a fountain located within a temple just north of Port Phasmatys that can be worshipped for Prayer experience.

name: Edgeville
blurb: Edgeville is a small town located at the border of the Wilderness.

name: Entrana
blurb: Entrana is a large island south-west of Taverley, occupied by Saradominist monks.

name: Falador
blurb: Falador is the capital city of the Kingdom of Asgarnia.

name: Ferox Enclave
blurb: Ferox Enclave is the restored remains of the Carrallanger fortress, once part of the Zarosian Empire before being abandoned and left to decay over the ages.

name: Fishing Guild
blurb: The Fishing Guild is a members-only guild located in a fenced area north of East Ardougne; west of Hemenster, which was released on 17 June 2002.

name: Fossil Island
blurb: Fossil Island is a members-only area located north-east of Morytania and unveils a unique environment where players can train a variety of skills.

name: Grand Exchange
blurb: The Grand Exchange, commonly referred to as the GE, is a trading system for players to purchase and sell tradeable items in Old School RuneScape.

name: Grand Tree
blurb: The Grand Tree, or Ta Quir Priw in gnomish language, is home to a gnome community and is built inside a tree in the north-east of the Tree Gnome Stronghold.

name: Hosidius
blurb: Hosidius is one of the five cities in the Kingdom of Great Kourend.

name: Ice Mountain
blurb: Ice Mountain is located just north-west of Barbarian Village, and the main entrance to the Dwarven Mine is located on its lower southern slope.

name: Jatizso
blurb: Jatizso (Jagex: yah-TIZZ-so) is one of the islands which make up the Fremennik Isles.

name: Kourend Castle
blurb: The Kourend Castle is a large castle found in the centre of Great Kourend, its courtyard directly flowing into the district of Kingstown.

name: Lava Maze
blurb: The Lava Maze is a maze located deep in the Wilderness, around level 40-45.

name: Lletya
blurb: Lletya (Welsh pronunciation: /ˈɬɛt.ə.a/, Jagex pronunciation: LLE-to-ah) is a small village that can be accessed after starting Mourning's End Part I. Eluned brings players to Lletya the first time…

name: Lovakengj
blurb: Lovakengj ( loh-və-KAYN) is one of the five cities in the Kingdom of Great Kourend, which resides in a volcanic area exclusively inhabited by dwarves.

name: Lumbridge
blurb: Lumbridge is a large town where players begin their Old School RuneScape journey.

name: Lumbridge Swamp
blurb: The Lumbridge Swamp is located south of Lumbridge and is east of Draynor Village.

name: Lunar Isle
blurb: Lunar Isle is a crescent-shaped island located in the Northern Ocean, occupied by the ancient Moon Clan.

name: Meiyerditch
blurb: Meiyerditch is a slum ruled by Lord Drakan and his family from the city of vampyres, Darkmeyer, the capital of Morytania.

name: Mining Guild
blurb: The Mining Guild, located in and beneath Falador, is a guild for expert miners available to players with at least 60 Mining (can be boosted).

name: Miscellania
blurb: Miscellania is an island kingdom in the Northern Ocean, north-west off the coast of the Fremennik Province.

name: Mor Ul Rek
blurb: Mor Ul Rek, also known as the TzHaar City, is a city located underneath the volcano on Karamja.

name: Mos Le'Harmless
blurb: Mos Le'Harmless is the quaint, pirate-run free port that can be visited after completion of the Cabin Fever quest.

name: Mount Karuulm
blurb: Mount Karuulm is a volcano found in the northern edge of the Kebos Lowlands.

name: Musa Point
blurb: Musa Point is a small settlement on the north-eastern edge of Karamja.

name: Nardah
blurb: Nardah is a town in the far south of the Kharidian Desert.

name: Neitiznot
blurb: Neitiznot (Jagex: NAY-tizz-not) is a fortified town on one of the Fremennik Isles that can be accessed by talking to Maria Gunnars on the most north-eastern pier in Rellekka.

name: Pollnivneach
blurb: Pollnivneach ( POL-niv-neech) is a town located in the middle of the Kharidian Desert, wherein the desert heat does not affect the player.

name: Port Khazard
blurb: Port Khazard is a port located south of Ardougne and north of Yanille.

name: Port Phasmatys
blurb: Port Phasmatys (Jagex: faz-MAT-iss) is a small town located on the north-eastern coast of Morytania.

name: Port Piscarilius
blurb: Port Piscarilius is one of the five cities in the Kingdom of Great Kourend.

name: Port Sarim
blurb: Port Sarim is a small port in south-eastern Asgarnia.

name: Rellekka
blurb: Rellekka is a village in the Fremennik Province.

name: Rimmington
blurb: Rimmington is a small village in south-west Asgarnia.

name: Seers' Village
blurb: Seers' Village is a small settlement to the west of Camelot, known for its white-robed residents who are capable of precognition.

name: Shantay Pass
blurb: The Shantay Pass is a small area that separates Al Kharid from the Kharidian Desert.

name: Shayzien
blurb: Shayzien is one of the five cities in the Kingdom of Great Kourend.

name: Shilo Village
blurb: Shilo Village is a small village in southern Karamja, accessible after completing the Shilo Village quest.

name: Sophanem
blurb: Sophanem, also known as the City of the Dead, is a plague-ridden city located in the southern end of the Kharidian Desert.

name: Tai Bwo Wannai
blurb: Tai Bwo Wannai, meaning 'small clearing in the jungle', is a village located south of Brimhaven in the jungle of Karamja.

name: Taverley
blurb: Taverley is a small Guthixian village found north-west of Falador inhabited primarily by druids.

name: Tree Gnome Stronghold
blurb: The Tree Gnome Stronghold, sometimes shortened to Gnome Stronghold, also called Ta Quir Priw in Gnomish, is one of the largest cities in Gielinor and is populated solely by gnomes.

name: Trollheim
blurb: Trollheim is a mountain in located in Troll Country.

name: Varlamore
blurb: The Kingdom of Varlamore, also known as the Shining Kingdom, is a kingdom on the continent of Zeah, far west of the mainland across the Western Ocean.

name: Varrock
blurb: Varrock (Jagex pronunciation: vah-ROCK) is the capital of the kingdom of Misthalin.

name: Varrock Square
blurb: Varrock Square is a square found directly south of Varrock Palace.

name: Void Knights' Outpost
blurb: The Void Knights' Outpost is a small island in the Ardent Ocean occupied by the Void Knights just south-west of Ape Atoll.

name: West Ardougne
blurb: West Ardougne is the western part of the capital city of Ardougne, which has been quarantined due to a mysterious plague.

name: Witchaven
blurb: Witchaven is a small village east of Ardougne.

name: Wizards' Tower
blurb: The Wizards' Tower is located south of Draynor Village, over a bridge.

name: Yanille
blurb: Yanille is a members-only city south of Ardougne, known for hosting Wizards' Guild.

name: Abandoned Mine
blurb: The Mort Ridge mines, are an old and deserted, hence more commonly known as the Abandoned Mine, multi-level mine complex under Morytania that once were the site of an extensive mining operation.

name: Agility Pyramid
blurb: The Agility Pyramid, also known as the Jaleustrophos Pyramid (meaning Tomb of the Agile in an old desert language), is an Agility training area located in the Kharidian Desert, between Sophanem and…

name: Ah Za Rhoon
blurb: Ah Za Rhoon, which means Magnificence Floating on Water in an ancient language, was an ancient temple in Karamja that was built by Zadimus and destroyed by Rashiliyia.

name: Al Kharid mine
blurb: The Al Kharid mine (also called Scorpion mine or Al Kharid Mining pit) is a Mining area located just north of the desert city of Al Kharid.

name: Al Kharid Palace
blurb: The Al Kharid Palace is the southernmost and largest building in the city of Al Kharid, and it is the residence of the Emir and the seat of government for the emirate of Al Kharid.

name: Ancient Pyramid
blurb: The Ancient Pyramid, also known as the Jaldraocht Pyramid, meaning Tomb of Magic in an old desert language, is located south of the Bandit Camp in the Kharidian Desert.

name: Ancient Vault
blurb: The Ancient Vault is an old Zarosian structure found in the eastern coast of the Kharidian Desert.

name: Ape Atoll Agility Course
blurb: The Ape Atoll Agility Course is an Agility training area located near Marim, available to players with level 48 Agility (cannot be boosted).

name: Ape Atoll Dungeon
blurb: The Ape Atoll Dungeon (also known as Zooknock's Tunnel) can be found in the southern jungle of Ape Atoll.

name: Arandar
blurb: Arandar is a mountain pass leading to Tirannwn that may be used by players upon completion of the Regicide quest.

name: Arceuus Library
blurb: The Arceuus Library, also known as the Grand Library of Great Kourend, is a large library found in Arceuus.

name: Ardougne
blurb: Ardougne (Jagex: (🔊listen) arr-DOYN) is the capital city of the Kingdom of Kandarin.

name: Ardougne Market
blurb: Ardougne Market, also called Ardougne Marketplace or the Equal Trade Market, is a large marketplace located in East Ardougne.

name: Ardougne Monastery
blurb: The Ardougne Monastery, or Kandarin Monastery, in the kingdom of Kandarin is a building located south of Ardougne Zoo and north of the Fight Arena.

name: Bandit Camp (Kharidian Desert)
blurb: The bandit camp in the Kharidian Desert is a small camp set up by bandits that will attack players wearing any Zamorakian or Saradominist items.

name: Bandit Camp (Wilderness)
blurb: The Bandit Camp is an outlaw stronghold located within levels 17-24 Wilderness.

name: Barbarian Outpost
blurb: The Barbarian Outpost is a fenced stronghold north-west of Baxtorian Falls and north of the Tree Gnome Stronghold.

name: Battlefield
blurb: The Battlefield is located south of West Ardougne, and north of Tree Gnome Village.

name: Bedabin Camp
blurb: The Bedabin Camp is a very small nomad camp south-west of Al Kharid and the Kalphite Lair.

name: Black Knights' Fortress
blurb: The Black Knights' Fortress is a castle of the Zamorakian military order of the Kinshra, commonly referred to as the black knights.

name: Blighted Volcano
blurb: The Blighted Volcano is a small volcanic outcrop in the north-eastern section of the Wilderness.

name: Bone Yard
blurb: The Bone Yard is located in level 32 Wilderness, and is populated by aggressive level 25 skeletons.

name: Bone Yard Hunter area
blurb: The Bone Yard Hunter area is located slightly south-east of the Bone Yard in the Wilderness.

name: Brine Rat Cavern
blurb: The Brine Rat Cavern, also known as Sven's cave, is a dungeon accessible during and after Olaf's Quest.

name: Brittle Isle
blurb: Brittle Isle is an island in the Northern Ocean requiring 81 Sailing to dock at, found north-west of Lunar Isle and north-east of Great Kourend.

name: Burthorpe Castle
blurb: Burthorpe Castle is the central feature of the principality of Burthorpe.

name: Cairn Isle
blurb: Cairn Isle is an island on the south-west of Karamja, south of Tai Bwo Wannai and west of Shilo Village.

name: Canal barge
blurb: The canal barge is a small ship built by the Varrockian Museum just north of the Digsite, east of Varrock.

name: Chaos Druid Tower
blurb: The Chaos Druid Tower is located to the north of Ardougne and is home to 4 chaos druids, located on the ground floor.

name: Chaos Temple (Asgarnia)
blurb: The Chaos Temple is a temple of Zamorak located north of Falador, north-west of Goblin Village.

name: Chaos Temple (church)
blurb: The Chaos Temple is a church in level 38 Wilderness, west of the Lava Maze.

name: Chaos Temple (Wilderness)
blurb: The Chaos Temple is a temple of Zamorak located around level 11 Wilderness, north of Varrock.

name: Charred Island
blurb: Charred Island is located south of the Void Knights' Outpost and Pest Control Island, in the Unquiet Ocean.

name: Chasm of Fire
blurb: The Chasm of Fire is a dungeon located in the north-west corner of Shayzien, housing a variety of demons led by Yama, the Master of Pacts.

name: Citharede Abbey
blurb: The Citharede Abbey is a small abandoned abbey found on the eastern end of the Giants' Plateau east of Al Kharid.

name: Clock Tower (building)
blurb: The Clock Tower is a tower south of Ardougne.

name: Coal Trucks
blurb: The Coal Trucks are located north of the Fishing Guild and west of McGrubor's Wood.

name: Combat Ring (Shayzien)
blurb: The combat ring is an arena in the Shayzien Encampment.

name: Combat Training Camp
blurb: The Combat Training Camp is a combat training facility which players may access upon completion of the Biohazard quest.

name: Cooks' Guild
blurb: The Cooks' Guild (also known as the Cooking Guild or the Chefs' Guild) is a guild for master chefs located in a three-story windmill west of Varrock.

name: Corsair Cove Resource Area
blurb: The Corsair Cove Resource Area is a gated resource-rich area in the north-west corner of the Corsair Cove.

name: Crash Island
blurb: Crash Island is a small island to the east of Ape Atoll.

name: Crash Site Cavern
blurb: The Crash Site Cavern is a cave located a very short distance north of the Tree Gnome Stronghold.

name: Daimon's Crater
blurb: Daimon's Crater is the location of the Bounty Hunter minigame and is only accessible on worlds 318 (UK), 319 (US West), or 569 (AUS).

name: Dark Warriors' Fortress
blurb: The Dark Warriors' Fortress is a castle in level 14 to 16 multi-combat Wilderness, north of Ice Mountain.

name: Death Plateau
blurb: The Death Plateau is a tall, flat land formation, surrounded by steep ascents, north-west of Burthorpe and directly north of the Warriors' Guild.

name: Demonic Ruins
blurb: The Demonic Ruins, originally known as Annakarl during the rule of Zaros, is a ruined fortress that is located in level 44-48 Wilderness.

name: Dense essence mine
blurb: The dense essence mine is located north-east of Arceuus.

name: Desert Mining Camp
blurb: The desert mining camp is a slave camp located south of Al Kharid in the Kharidian Desert, run by Captain Siad.

name: Diango's Workshop
blurb: Diango's Workshop is an underground factory in Draynor Village which was accessed via the trapdoor found in the north-westernmost house in Draynor Village.

name: Dragontooth Island
blurb: Dragontooth Island is an island located in the north-east of Gielinor.

name: Eagles' Peak
blurb: Eagles' Peak is a relatively small mountain located in the south of Piscatoris.

name: Edgeville bank
blurb: The Edgeville bank, also known as edge bank, is a popular bank found in Edgeville, east of the Grand Exchange and just below the Wilderness ditch.

name: Edgeville Monastery
blurb: The Edgeville Monastery, also referred to as simply the Monastery, is a two-story building north-east of Falador, east of the Black Knights' Fortress and west of Edgeville.

name: Elemental Workshop
blurb: The Elemental Workshop is a dungeon that players can progressively explore more of as they complete the Elemental Workshop quest series.

name: Etceteria
blurb: Etceteria is an island kingdom in the Northern Ocean, north-west off the coast of the Fremennik Province.

name: Exam Centre
blurb: The Exam Centre is a location in Misthalin (found south-east of Varrock, directly south of the Digsite) that is central to several quests.

name: Experiment cave
blurb: The experiment cave is a cave first accessed during the quest Creature of Fenkenstrain, and is used by players to train melee skills.

name: Falador Park
blurb: The Falador Park is a large, fenced-in park found in Falador.

name: Farming Guild
blurb: The Farming Guild is a members-only guild located within the Kebos Lowlands just north of the Kebos Swamp.

name: Feldip Hunter area
blurb: The Feldip Hunter area is one of several Hunter training areas.

name: Fenkenstrain's Castle
blurb: Fenkenstrain's Castle is a castle in northern Morytania, north-east of Canifis, and north of the Haunted Woods.

name: Fight Arena
blurb: The Fight Arena is a large structure south of Ardougne.

name: Fishing Platform
blurb: The Fishing Platform is located in the Ardent Ocean due east of Witchaven.

name: Frozen Waste Plateau
blurb: The Frozen Waste Plateau, also known as Ice Plateau (or historically Ghorrock), is located in the north-west corner of the Wilderness.

name: Ghorrock
blurb: Ghorrock is an abandoned Zarosian fortress historically located in the north-west corner of the Zarosian Empire during the Second Age.

name: Giants' Plateau
blurb: The Giants' Plateau is an area found east of Al Kharid.

name: Glarial's Tomb
blurb: Glarial's Tomb is a dungeon underneath the tombstone near the Baxtorian Falls and the Kingdom of Kandarin.

name: Gnome Stronghold Agility Course
blurb: The Gnome Stronghold Agility Course is an Agility course in which the player must traverse obstacles consisting of a log balance, obstacle nets, tightropes, and pipes.

name: Goblin settlement
blurb: The goblin settlement is a small camp found in the ruins east of the Observatory.

name: Graveyard of Heroes
blurb: The Graveyard of Heroes is located in the south-western part of Shayzien.

name: Gu'Tanoth
blurb: Gu'Tanoth is an ogre city far south of Ardougne and slightly south-west of Yanille.

name: Gwenith
blurb: Gwenith is a small village north-west of Prifddinas, in the shadow of the mountain of Mynydd.

name: H.A.M. Hideout
blurb: The H.A.M. Hideout is the base of operations for the Humans Against Monsters organisation.

name: Hardwood Grove
blurb: The Hardwood grove is a fenced area just north-east of Tai Bwo Wannai village, in order to cut the trees inside, the player must have done some of the Tai Bwo Wannai Cleanup minigame.

name: Harmony Island
blurb: Harmony Island was once a peaceful island full of monks, but it was taken over by zombie pirates who turned the monks undead.

name: Haunted Woods
blurb: The Haunted Woods is a large swampy forest in Morytania.

name: Hosidius Kitchen
blurb: The Hosidius kitchen is a small building located in the north-west corner of Hosidius, just east of the Mess.

name: House on the Hill
blurb: The House on the Hill is a location on Fossil Island.

name: Ice Path
blurb: The Ice Path is a path ascending up a mountain, in the Troll Country region of Gielinor.

name: Iorwerth Camp
blurb: The Iorwerth Camp is a small camp outside Prifddinas, occupied by elf warriors under the command of Lord Iorwerth.

name: Isafdar
blurb: Isafdar (Jagex pronunciation: ISS-aff-dar) is the elven forest.

name: Island of Stone
blurb: The Island of Stone is an island in the Northern Ocean, accessible for the first time during The Fremennik Exiles.

name: Isle of Souls
blurb: The Isle of Souls is an island located in the Shrouded Ocean, west of Feldip Hills.

name: Jalsavrah Pyramid
blurb: The Jalsavrah Pyramid, whose name translates to Tomb of Kings, is (presumably) the burial site of past pharaohs, and is the location of the Pyramid Plunder minigame.

name: Jaltevas Pyramid
blurb: Jaltevas Pyramid, whose name translates to Tomb of the Father, is a large pyramid found in the necropolis on the south-eastern coast of the Kharidian Desert.

name: Jiggig
blurb: Jiggig is a former ogre ritual site, located south of Castle Wars.

name: Kalphite Cave
blurb: The Kalphite Cave is a dungeon located east of the Shantay Pass, housing kalphites that can only be killed while on a Slayer task.

name: Karamja
blurb: Karamja is a large island in Gielinor.

name: Karamjan Temple
blurb: The Karamjan Temple is a large maze found beneath the Kharazi Jungle visited during Dragon Slayer II. In order to reach the temple, players must travel to south-east corner of the Kharazi Jungle, and…

name: Kebos Swamp
blurb: The Kebos Swamp is a swamp located in the Kebos Lowlands north of Mount Quidamortem.

name: Keep Le Faye
blurb: Keep Le Faye is a tower south of Camelot Castle, and directly east of Sorcerer's Tower.

name: Kharazi Jungle
blurb: The Kharazi Jungle is an area south of Shilo Village on Karamja.

name: Kharid-et
blurb: Kharid-et was a Zarosian settlement dating back to the Second Age.

name: Kingstown
blurb: Kingstown is a town located in the centre of Great Kourend, made up of Kourend Castle, its courtyard, and multiple houses to the east of the courtyard.

name: Klenter's Pyramid
blurb: Klenter's Pyramid is one of the two pyramids in Sophanem, the other being Jalsavrah.

name: Kourend Woodland
blurb: The Kourend Woodland is an area found in the southern coast of Great Kourend.

name: Kraken Cove
blurb: The Kraken Cove is a dungeon full of underground lakes located in Piscatoris, south-west of the Piscatoris Fishing Colony, housing waterfiends, cave krakens, and the Kraken boss.

name: Kruk's Dungeon
blurb: Kruk's Dungeon is a large labyrinth whose entrance is hidden under jungle grass west of Marim on Ape Atoll.

name: Lake Molch
blurb: Lake Molch is a large lake found just west of Great Kourend.

name: Land's End
blurb: Land's End is a small village in Great Kourend that is located in the south-western corner of the kingdom, within its Woodland.

name: Lassar
blurb: Lassar was a Zarosian fortress built on what is now known as Ice Mountain.

name: Last Light
blurb: Last Light is an island located in the Unquiet Ocean.

name: Lava Dragon Isle
blurb: The Lava Dragon Isle is a members-only section of the Wilderness which stretches from level 36 to level 42.

name: Legends' Guild
blurb: The Legends' Guild is the second most exclusive of the quest-based guilds in Old School RuneScape (with the Myths' Guild being the first).

name: Library Historical Archive
blurb: The Library Historical Archive is small area within Arceuus accessible only by speaking to Archeio, the archive's guardian, on the Arceuus Library ground floor.

name: Lighthouse
blurb: The Lighthouse is an area north of the Barbarian Outpost, and features prominently in the Horror from the Deep quest.

name: Limestone Mine
blurb: The Limestone Mine is a mining location which lies on Silvarea west of the temple Paterdomus and north-east of Varrock.

name: Lithkren
blurb: Lithkren is an island found north-west of Fossil Island.

name: Lizardman Caves
blurb: The Lizardman Caves are a series of caves located at the north-west corner of the Lizardman Settlement in the Kebos Lowlands.

name: Lumber Yard
blurb: The Lumber Yard is a location north-east of Varrock.

name: Lumbridge Castle
blurb: Lumbridge Castle is a large castle located in Lumbridge and home of Duke Horacio.

name: Lunar Isle mine
blurb: The Lunar Isle mine (also called the Lunar mine) is located in the north-eastern part of Lunar Isle.

name: Mac's island
blurb: Mac's island is an island in Merwick Lake located west of the Warriors' Guild where Mac may be found.

name: Mage Arena
blurb: The Mage Arena is a members-only combat area located deep in the Wilderness.

name: Mage Arena bank
blurb: The Mage Arena bank, also known as the mage bank or wildy bank, is a bank located deep within the Wilderness underneath a crumbling building north of the Mage Arena.

name: Marim
blurb: Marim is a settlement on Ape Atoll, inhabited by a population of societal monkeys who are ruled over by King Awowogei.

name: Mausoleum
blurb: The Mausoleum is a small graveyard located on a small island off the coast of Morytania.

name: Melzar's Maze
blurb: Melzar's Maze is a large, three-story building with a basement located north-west of Rimmington.

name: Mess
blurb: The Mess is a minigame located in the Mess Hall just south of Kingstown in Great Kourend, in which players cook and serve food to Shayzien soldiers.

name: Miscellania Castle
blurb: Miscellania Castle is the residence of King Vargas, ruler of the small island-kingdom of Miscellania, neighbour to the smaller island town Etceteria.

name: Mistrock
blurb: Mistrock is a dwarven settlement on the island of Aldarin, located in the region of Varlamore.

name: Mort Myre Swamp
blurb: The Mort Myre Swamp, once a forest known as Humblethorn, is a swampland in western Morytania.

name: Mort'ton
blurb: Mort'ton (Jagex: , ) is a small, dilapidated town in the Mort Myre Swamp, inhabited by afflicted humans and ghostly shades.

name: Mount Quidamortem
blurb: Mount Quidamortem ( KWID-ər-mort-əm) is a mountain in the Kebos Lowlands.
